observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are used. No tier is assigned; score is abstained.

observations.behavior: Adds frame timeline and pre-roll frame support to session replay playback and recording, including a new timeline-emitting bridge, a frame-recording playback controller, and a new timestamp-computation function that uses actual recorded frames rather than predicted durations.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to record the exact frame positions during playback and use them to compute accurate video timestamps, accounting for skipped inactive segments and pre-roll frames, rather than relying on predicted durations.

observations.behavior: Adds the frame_timeline message type and PLAYER_FRAME_TIMELINE_KEY constant to the player protocol.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines the protocol extension needed for the player to emit frame timeline data back to the host.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No score is assigned; tier requires assessment of broader systemic benefit and validation, not just implementation. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds frame_session_ms and pre_roll_frames fields to RecordingResult and their use in rasterization.
observations.posthog_connection: Stores measured session time at each captured frame, including pre-roll, for later video-clock alignment.

observations.behavior: Adds frame_timeline case and frameSessionMs state to PlayerController; provides readFrameTimeline and getFrameSessionMs.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows Player to receive and store frame timeline from page, and read it after capture, even if replayer never finished.

observations.behavior: Replaces computeVideoTimestamps with videoTimestampsFromFrames, passing frame_session_ms and other metadata; retains fallback to old behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: Uses measured frame timeline to compute video-clock positions, accounting for skipped frames and pre-roll, rather than relying solely on session-clock derivation.
